t: You're at the site of St Laurence Pountney, a Church of England parish church in the Candlewick ward of the City. It was destroyed in the Great Fire of 1666 and was never rebuilt, so nothing of it stands today. Charles Rogers, who died in 1784, was buried here. He worked as a customs official and was known as an art collector. He also wrote on drawings, and became a Fellow of the Royal Society.
